thread:
Mira: FYI I reproduced a weird token duplication when bringing up codexica-36k int4 on staging. only happens on long prefill runs (>28k) and only when the cache reattach triggers during generation.
Sam: can you show a minimal repro + diff? :mag:
Mira: repro command (staging GPU pool):
```bash
./rundebug --model codexica-36k-int4 --context 36000 --prefill tests/long_batch_01.txt --dump-kv --rotary-scale 1.0
```
Mira: observed: reference: "...and the board voted to proceed." -> quant: "...and the board voted to proceed. proceed." (duplicate trailing phrase inserted; later tokens shift).
Priya: duplication suggests the KV pointer repeated a small window during reconcat. did you capture the raw token ids around the stitchpoint?
Mira: yes. token ids around 30012: [30008,30009,30010,30011,30012,30013] then after reattach we see [30008,30009,30010,30011,30011,30012,30013] (duplicate 30011).
Tom: that's an off-by-one repeat, not a dropout. could be an index clamp/overflow when compressing offsets in the int4 packing path. any rotary mismatches?
Mira: ran fp16 run: no duplicate. ran int8: rare. int4: deterministic on our staging binary.
Sam: please attach the KV stamps and the handshake logs. can you run with `--kv-suture-check` (new flag) that asserts contiguous indices after reattach?
Mira: I added a quick patch locally that logs the suture check: `SUTURE: shard=3 pre=30011 post=30011 gap=1` which triggered.
Priya: gap=1 meaning a duplicated previous index. we should add a unit test that simulates a mid-token reattach and verifies no repeated ids. also add a rotary-scale sweep to check sensitivity: 0.999, 1.0, 1.001.
Sam: good call. could be the quant packer rounding makes the handshake comparator take a different code path and replay one token. bisect candidate: recent int4 packing change in commit 9f4a2c.
Tom: I'll do the bisect. also let's run a small matrix: 10 failing prompts x {fp16,int8,int4} x rotary-scale {0.999,1.0,1.001} and collect KV fingerprints.
Mira: uploading the 10 prompts + raw kv dumps into ML-2510 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-2510). I included the exact offending token lists and binary dumps.
deploy-bot: queued job ml/evals token-suture-matrix #202 (expected ~3h). logs live: https://ci.internal/runs/202
Sam: can someone try `--rotary-scale=1.0002` as well? sometimes tiny offsets flip the comparator.
Priya: I will add a defensive `stitchpoint_assert` in the reattach codepath that rejects duplicate indices and logs a full memory snapshot for triage. failing the request is harsh but acceptable in staging until we root cause.
Mira: thanks team. Tom, ping me when your bisect narrows to a commit; I'll run the reproducible harness and produce a reduced repro.
Tom: will do. Tentative sync tomo 9:30am PT.
Mira: adding short notes and a couple of local traces to the ticket now. :memo:
